text:
I'm sorry, but I don't have a policy on changing or cancelling an order after it's placed, so I can't confirm whether yours can still be changed. I can escalate this to a Support Lead to check, so tell me what you'd like to change (items, address, or cancelling) and I'll pass it along.

If you'd rather wait until it arrives, non-living items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, and there are no direct exchanges (you return the item and place a new order). Live plants can't be returned for change of mind.
